alex_stjohn_: Walter Stjohn joined the replacements on Day 11. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Walter Stjohn watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
ami_ne_dz13: The old hands of R-C1 have been here since Day 1. Henrik Ami has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

A round went through Henrik Ami's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Isidor Hohlmike of the Hegemony (@hohlmike4). The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into R-C1. Henrik Ami has learned to walk bent double.

Henrik Ami walked back up the communication trench to R-C1, slower than before, but on his own feet. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Henrik Ami is number 788. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Henrik Ami kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
bartdrent: "You're late," said the corporal when Wendel Bartdrent arrived on Day 8. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
A parcel came for Wendel Bartdrent that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: two knitted scarves. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-S3 and grazed Wendel Bartdrent's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Bram Toaster of the Hegemony (@glorified_toaster). The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Wendel Bartdrent watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools. A letter from home reached Wendel Bartdrent before dusk. Wendel Bartdrent read it twice and slept a little easier.

The medic cut the last bandage off Wendel Bartdrent's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to R-S3 the same hour. Wendel Bartdrent got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 543. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Wendel Bartdrent stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
cko1945: Ivo Cko arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a rosary of rough beads and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at S-R7 changed before the cheering ended. Ivo Cko shouldered another load.

Ivo Cko and Florian Jthompson made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Ivo Cko shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
cthulhu1703: Day 10. The corporal put Walter "Spark" Cthulhu beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Walter "Spark" Cthulhu borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Ulrich Stalierino was grazed. Walter "Spark" Cthulhu reached up to fix a sandbag at P-F9 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Otto "Shadow" Ghost of the Hegemony (@tf141simon_riley_ghost). The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In P-F9, Walter "Spark" Cthulhu listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
dragos.jrca: Isidor Jrca arrived at S-S1 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.

Isidor Jrca was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-S1. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Nils Noah of the Concord (@noah813768). The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Isidor Jrca helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Back on the fire step at S-S1. Isidor Jrca says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Isidor Jrca is number 644. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Victory at Grey Mill. Isidor Jrca let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
embersky446: By the time Konrad Embersky reached R-R2, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

Machine-gun fire swept R-R2. Konrad Embersky took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Bastian Mrbojo of the Concord (@mrbojo1992). The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Konrad Embersky did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

There was never a bed for Konrad Embersky, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to R-R2 on his own feet. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Konrad Embersky wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
garbet7532: Gideon Garbet arrived with the Day 10 draft, carrying a rosary of rough beads and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

Casimir Joncheng and Gideon Garbet carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gideon Garbet. Gideon Garbet read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Gideon Garbet read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
gaunt_ghost_611: The draft reached Q-F23 on Day 10. Viktor Ghost was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Fresh from training, Viktor Ghost still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Gideon "Mole" Isaacburston, grazed. The sergeant at Q-F23 called out a range and a spot. Viktor Ghost was the only one who hit it. Rafael "Saint" Arthur was gravely wounded. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Viktor Ghost helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
gregoriousdonder: Nils Gregoriousdo unpacked a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts at S-C2. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.

Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Nils Gregoriousdo could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable. A letter from home reached Nils Gregoriousdo before dusk. Nils Gregoriousdo read it twice and slept a little easier.

At S-C2 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Nils Gregoriousdo won the bet. Rafael Ware was grazed. Nils Gregoriousdo fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Emil Awan was badly wounded. Nils Gregoriousdo ate breakfast without a word. A letter from home reached Nils Gregoriousdo before dusk. Nils Gregoriousdo read it twice and slept a little easier. Nils Gregoriousdo got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 863. The men who came later will ask about it. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Nils Gregoriousdo shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
guacamole_1354: The new rifleman is Henrik Guacamole, once a bookbinder from Coldwater. The corporal asked if a bookbinder was any use in a trench. Henrik Guacamole said he would find out.

The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Henrik Guacamole fired, and Casimir Olo was badly wounded. The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In S-R4, Henrik Guacamole listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Henrik Guacamole's ear at S-R4 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Henrik Dmt of the Hegemony (@rares.dmt_). Henrik Guacamole got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 951. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Henrik Guacamole kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
kat_catto: Yann Catto, a railway porter from Old Harrow, was sent forward on Day 11 to fill a gap in V-F17. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
kusziko: On Day 10, Valentin "Whistle" Kusziko arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

Valentin "Whistle" Kusziko carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Valentin "Whistle" Kusziko during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
mcdonnell_cody: The new stretcher bearer gave his name as Roland Cody. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into V-F8. Roland Cody has learned to walk bent double.
noah_the_0ne: The new rifleman gave his name as Albin The. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.

Albin The was hit twice at S-C4, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Silas Kmec of the Hegemony (@rastislav_kmec). Albin The looked over the parapet at S-C4 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Silas Kmec of the Hegemony (@rastislav_kmec).
Quentin The put a pressed cornflower beside the bunk. Someone who had known Albin The helped clear the shelf without saying why.

A man asked Quentin The to describe Esterhaus without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch. Quentin The got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 743. The men who came later will ask about it. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached S-C4 with the rations. Quentin The ate while listening to the revised orders.
pathfinder074: Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded. The new duty roster listed Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder as a chaplain. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder helped stack spare sandbags at Q-S10. Nobody asked when they would be needed. A letter from home reached Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder before dusk. Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder read it twice and slept a little easier.

Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder of the Concord and Hugo Karl of the Hegemony share the same habit: a whistle at midnight. Both lines at Hill 304 now wait for it before they sleep. A letter from home reached Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder before dusk. Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder read it twice and slept a little easier. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
varsikasikranaatti: Felix Varsikasikra reported to S-F12 with a lock of hair in a matchbox sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Felix Varsikasikra is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave.
Felix Varsikasikra taught Severin Sky to play the harmonica. The bay has asked them both, formally, to stop.
The Concord won Verdel Ridge. In S-F12, Felix Varsikasikra listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Felix Varsikasikra saw Severin Heheheha freeze up on the fire step at the Sunken Road. Felix said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.
Felix Varsikasikra checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone.

The barrage caught Felix Varsikasikra in the open at S-F12. The medic tied two tourniquets and shouted for a bed. A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Felix Varsikasikra was carried in at last. Felix Varsikasikra is out of danger. Still bedridden, still bandaged, but out of danger. The Hegemony took Hill 304, and the orders at S-F12 changed before the cheering ended. Felix Varsikasikra shouldered another load.

The man in the next bed snored all day. Felix Varsikasikra did not mind. It meant someone was still breathing. A letter from home reached Felix Varsikasikra before dusk. Felix Varsikasikra read it twice and slept a little easier.
There was never a bed for Felix Varsikasikra, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to S-F12 on his own feet.

Felix Varsikasikra traded a lock of hair in a matchbox for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it. A letter from home reached Felix Varsikasikra before dusk. Felix Varsikasikra read it twice and slept a little easier.

Felix Varsikasikra and the spotter took turns with the telescope for half a day, talking only in numbers. At the last number Felix Varsikasikra fired. Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants was badly wounded. Felix Varsikasikra let the enemy fix the same sandbag three times. The fourth time, Valentin Zle was badly wounded. A letter from home reached Felix Varsikasikra before dusk. Felix Varsikasikra read it twice and slept a little easier.

Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Felix Varsikasikra only heard boots on the duckboards at S-F12, then nothing but pain. Raider: Isidor Glc of the Concord (@leo.glc). Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Felix Varsikasikra watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work. A letter from home reached Felix Varsikasikra before dusk. Felix Varsikasikra read it twice and slept a little easier.

Felix Varsikasikra lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk. A letter from home reached Felix Varsikasikra before dusk. Felix Varsikasikra read it twice and slept a little easier. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Felix Varsikasikra helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
walt_tmn: By the time Roland Tmn reached U-F13, the war was 10 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

Frost made each footprint distinct. Roland Tmn followed a trail to the missing ration sack and found the quartermaster sitting on it. Mail came up the line with a letter for Roland Tmn. Roland Tmn read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Victory at Grey Mill. Roland Tmn let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
whispertooth: Anselm Whispertooth reported to R-R1 with a cracked shaving mirror sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.

Anselm Whispertooth had watched a loose sandbag in the enemy wall for two days. This morning it moved. Gustav "Brick" Floooring was badly wounded. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Anselm Whispertooth read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Anselm Whispertooth's ear at R-R1 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Marek Seths of the Hegemony (@seths110). Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Anselm Whispertooth wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
